presentation.label: 32 shared sample voices
presentation.summary: Polyphonic FLEX playback with a shared 32-voice pool and independent track tuning.
presentation.overview: One POLY track can use all 32 free voices. Each head has a preallocated AMP envelope; filters and FX remain shared per track. Draft outside the catalog.
highlights: 32 voices shared across tracks; up to 32 on one track.
Independent ATK/HOLD/REL, with no per-note DSP or heap allocation.
Ten panel octave positions and dedicated-route MIDI notes 0–127.
PTCH tunes the chord; POLY opens FLEX samples directly.
usage: Select an audio track, open SRC SETUP, choose POLY and press YES.
POLY opens the FLEX sample pool directly. Load a sample with the stock file browser, then confirm its slot with YES. NO leaves the browser.
Return to SRC and enter chromatic mode with FUNC+DOWN. Hold several trig keys; FUNC+LEFT/RIGHT changes octave from -6 to +3.
Turn PTCH to transpose the sounding chord. A dedicated POLY MIDI channel accepts notes 0–127; note 84 plays the tuned sample root.
Set AMP REL to a finite value for notes that end after key-up. All POLY tracks share 32 voices, and one track can use the entire free pool.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.description: Track-wide sample tuning. Note input adds an independent semitone offset; all held/releasing voices follow tuning changes.

controls.name: Chromatic octave
controls.description: FUNC+LEFT/RIGHT selects -6 to +3; the display shows the full signed value. Panel covers MIDI 0–124.

controls.name: Sample pool
controls.description: Native FLEX slot browser opens directly. STATIC is unavailable in this draft.

limitations: Draft outside the catalog; no downloadable firmware or public build package.
TSTR is OFF while POLY is active.
FLEX only; STATIC requires independent streaming-cache support.
Panel/MIDI note recording is incomplete; extended pitches are a live-play feature.
MIDI channels shared with non-POLY audio tracks keep stock note-command mapping outside 72–96.
Linear interpolation can alias at high pitches; no anti-aliasing upgrade is claimed.
Ratios saturate below 32× rather than fold by octaves; very low pitches are limited by Q16 playback phase.
The octave selector is a global live control; it is not saved per Part.
No coexistence with other row-five custom machines is claimed.

memory.label: Shared platform reserve
memory.conditions: Reserved once by the shared platform; POLY runtime sits inside it. Sample RAM is reduced by this reservation.

processing.label: ColdFire playback
processing.conditions: Native emulator instruction counts are not hardware cycles. Maximum-pitch 32-voice deadlines need qualification.

tests.summary: Native build, bounded allocator and stealing, current-pool MIDI/release checks, emulator audio and UI. Physical hardware is untested.

license.declaration: Full upstream MIT terms and snapshot identities retained. VECTOR adapter attribution retained. Firmware, stock dumps, card images and built output stay private.
